decision: Pin official archive and file hashes; preserve raw bytes.
Require identical ordered feature columns, valid labels and numeric tokens.
Convert documented na tokens to nullable values; preserve observed zero.
Keep incomplete records and class mix; do not silently deduplicate.
Keep all original features in conservative clean exports; flag sparse/constant values.
